name: Display Layout
author: Badr-Emil
description: Arrange and rotate your displays and choose which workspace number each one shows, right from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Shows every connected display as a tile you can drag next to the others, rotate, and give a workspace number. The result can be tried live and saved to monitors.lua.
